description.para: This parameter controls whether Samba allows WSP queries on a share. For controlling indexing of filesystems you may also have to use the associated indexer's own configuration system or tools.

listitem.para: Samba must be configured and built with WSP support.
The wsp service must be enabled, see below.
The associated supported wsp backend must be setup and the share content indexed.

description.para: For a detailed set of instructions please see https://wiki.samba.org/index.php/WSP.
The WSP service is started automatically if global 'wsp backend' is set to a supported backend (other than the default 'none')
